reviewer: bios_v09 AI agent, second editorial pass; not a human or official approval
selfCritique: The first draft incorrectly treated structural test success as editorial readiness. Splitting short resumes at commas produced dependent clauses. Some first-three-sentence excerpts described only equipment or dialogue without context, and many NPC entries substituted admonitions for biography. The previous final assessment was premature.
reviewMethod: Read every canonical profile and all three sentences for independent meaning, identity, relevant history, and chronology.
Re-read complete official local archives for short profiles, robots, collaborations, alternate forms, and uncertain identities.
Cross-check NPC names against operator archives, preserve historical phases, and avoid inventing unverified early lives.
Freeze all approved prose in editorial source and remove automatic sentence splitting and demographic filler generation.
resolvedIssues: Rewrote dangling clauses and removed comma-based sentence generation.
Linked four story identities to operator records: Byochok to Vetochki, Styopa to Viy, Mantra to the Chinese operator name, and Eblana to her playable identity.
Corrected Naga: the figure living with Vetochki was a Holy Fool using her deceased grandmother identity.
Distinguished the possible future in Skadi the Corrupting Heart archives from established main-story events.
Expanded brief equipment-only biographies using career changes, life history, and collaboration events.
Verified Skybox name, gender, senior agency role, and restored Propeller Paradise command against his official resume.
Preserved governing institutions as institutions instead of fabricating individual life stories.
